summary: K Wave Media Ltd. filed a Form 6-K announcing that a prospectus supplement filed on August 3, 2026, for an at-the-market offering of up to $5,058,329 of ordinary shares was made in error. No equity distribution agreement has been entered into with D. Boral Capital LLC, and no sales have been or will be made under the supplement. The company intends to file a terminating supplement. This is a routine regulatory correction with no special-situation event; the ATM offering is being withdrawn.
